Cullinan Associates Inc decreased its stake in Wal (WMT) by 2.15% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 3.17M shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $282.17 million, down from 3.24M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cullinan Associates Inc who had been investing in Wal for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $248.49 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.72% or $0.6 during the last trading session, reaching $84.21. About 8.09 million shares traded. Walmart Inc. (NYSE:WMT) has risen 5.30% since June 22, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 7.27% the S&P500.
Cullinan Associates Inc, which manages about $1.27B and $1.32 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in S&P Global Inc. by 228,800 shares to 398,800 shares, valued at $76.20 million in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 35,679 shares in the quarter, for a total of 262,026 shares, and has risen its stake in Eaton Corp (NYSE:ETN).
Analysts await Walmart Inc. (NYSE:WMT) to report earnings on August, 16. They expect $1.22 earnings per share, up 12.96 % or $0.14 from last year’s $1.08 per share. WMT’s profit will be $3.60 billion for 17.26 P/E if the $1.22 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.14 actual earnings per share reported by Walmart Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 7.02 % EPS growth.
